scope: minimum evidence for a first read-only bounded real shadow; not Root-R6A2B execution and not production fusion

prerequisites.current_evidence: identity, -Y groundward/gold-UWB-end convention, outward side, and session placements are operator-attested; full signed +X and real axis validation remain pending and angular uncertainty is unquantified
prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: record one labelled neutral donning action for all ten nodes; bind full signed sensor axes to each hardware family and attach a finite angular uncertainty/cone
prerequisites.production_distinction: production may require independent enclosure-PCB-IMU metrology; the first shadow needs only a bounded, session-bound signed transform

prerequisites.current_evidence: synthetic noise is test-only; ten-device multi-temperature real electronic-noise qualification is absent
prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: for the first shadow, use an explicitly conservative bounded prior and sensitivity bracket without writing a real slot; complete per-device multi-temperature characterization before production claims
prerequisites.production_distinction: exact device-specific noise/RW fitting is not required to ingest a read-only bounded shadow

prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: declare population/subject bounds for segment geometry and propagate them as uncertainty; do not thaw the real ledger
prerequisites.production_distinction: qualified subject measurements improve attribution and accuracy

prerequisites.current_evidence: wrist/ankle landmark metrology is deferred under precise definitions
prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: omit distal outputs or attach broad declared bounds in the first shadow
prerequisites.production_distinction: measure the four declared landmarks for accurate distal endpoint reporting

prerequisites.current_evidence: topology is sealed; numerical anatomical joint/rest priors are deferred
prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: use broad literature/anatomical bounds with sensitivity reporting and no real-slot write
prerequisites.production_distinction: subject/session qualification is required before precise clinical or performance interpretation

prerequisites.current_evidence: COMMON_NINE_V0_20_PCB17 is hash-bound to common Gerber, STEP, and enclosure-base CAD for exactly nine named nodes
prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: import the sealed family binding by hash and reject cross-family transform reuse
prerequisites.production_distinction: exact internal sensor/antenna transforms remain a separate prerequisite

prerequisites.current_evidence: BSF31CC_V0_20_N5BL is a distinct one-node family; its PCB/band attachment, outward component side, -Y down marker, and operator-measured 6 mm band-to-PCB-bottom distance are sealed with pending uncertainty
prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: import only the BSF31CC family binding and its recorded evidence; never reuse common-nine mechanical transforms
prerequisites.production_distinction: button frame, IMU die origin, and RF phase centre remain unresolved

prerequisites.current_evidence: CAD identifies board component references and the large gold UWB antenna region, but no unique UWB point, phase-centre bound, or IMU die-origin transform is qualified; BSF31CC is mechanically distinct
prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: derive one CAD nominal lever and finite RF/IMU-origin uncertainty for the common-nine family and a separate one for BSF31CC; use them as read-only bounded priors
prerequisites.production_distinction: RF/metrology qualification can refine these later; a zero-uncertainty or cross-family lever is forbidden

prerequisites.current_evidence: V4 is qualified only as capture-bound relative geometry; T_N_V4 is null and the prior frame-binding result is rank one
prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: supply a qualified survey or labelled gravity-plus-heading bridge with covariance for the named capture
prerequisites.production_distinction: display-frame axes cannot substitute for this estimation-frame bridge

prerequisites.current_evidence: the named C1 capture is hash-bound to current_room_autopos_20260811_183541 layout, manifest, reference, and delay convention
prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: import by deployment/capture hashes and reject cross-deployment reuse or body-motion recalibration
prerequisites.production_distinction: a new deployment requires a new bound geometry package

prerequisites.current_evidence: ten ClockModels are sealed per node, boot_epoch, decoder, and named capture with residual sigma
prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: import only after exact node/boot/capture/hash match; propagate sigma and reject generic reuse
prerequisites.production_distinction: ClockModels are capture-derived relationships, not independent static calibration slots

prerequisites.current_evidence: the qualified structure is a temporally smooth SO(3) nuisance, not one of the 87 slots; numerical bounds are unmeasured
prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: use a conservative near-zero reset prior plus finite magnitude/rate sensitivity bracket and report dependence; do not estimate an unconstrained per-sample extrinsic
prerequisites.production_distinction: repeated labelled neutral returns can later qualify session-specific bounds

prerequisites.current_evidence: origin/yaw/protocol relationship remain null because T_N_V4 and T_N_P are unresolved
prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: derive the gauge after the V4-navigation bridge and declared convention are fixed; do not independently fit it from body motion
prerequisites.production_distinction: world_model_gauge remains null until its dependencies are qualified

prerequisites.current_evidence: Root-R6A1B records that torso_top has no exact physical landmark definition
prerequisites.minimum_qualification_action: declare an unambiguous anatomical landmark definition and a broad bound; precise metrology is not required for the first shadow
prerequisites.production_distinction: a definition is mandatory now; precise subject measurement can follow

first_shadow_entry_criterion: all four minimum blocker actions completed, all imported capture hashes exact, every bounded prior explicit and sensitivity-tested, and execution remains read-only with zero real-slot writes
